cautions: An address acknowledgement alone does not identify this device.
Read one ID byte only on a reviewed I2C connection; do not call full driver initialization as a probe.
Verified means the BMP388 chip-ID rule matched, not a verified breakout, voltage, wiring or unique serial number.
The chip also supports SPI, but this descriptor and the current platform binding support I2C only.
Listen using the descriptor's UART settings; do not transmit discovery commands or cycle through baud rates.
Use complete reports accepted by the existing parser, not a header-only match. Any receive error invalidates the current observation window.
Three reports in 1000 ms is an initial project policy, not a manufacturer guarantee or measured discovery latency.
A matching stream establishes a compatible protocol candidate; the user still confirms the module model.
A valid report with zero targets means the radar is responding. Silence does not prove it is unplugged.

identification.confirmation: Confirm the module, interface straps and wiring; after reviewed activation, confirm that a test display is readable.

cautions: The tested six-pin OLED has no exposed chip-select or readback. SPI transfer success does not establish its presence or exact controller identity.
Use this six-pin module alone on its SPI bus. A shared-bus preset requires separate review and independently controlled chip-selects.
The bench profile reserves GPIO4 for the existing driver even though the six-pin module has no wire connected to it.
